comments: Child corrects their own color identification from green to red.
Child corrects the caregiver's question 'šel mi ?' (Whose?) by asserting 'No, this is Dad's'. The caregiver's uptake 'naḳōn' (Right) confirms a positive identification was made.
Child refuses mother's offer to fix the watch ('bōʔi nesadēr laḳ' in line 9354), wanting to do it themselves.
Child states that nothing is written in the picture in response to 'ma katuv batmuna ?', indicating the absence of text.
Child asserts that the object is not a cube; this is a truth claim about the object's identity.
Child denies the mother's claim that the ear is wet (line 22559).
Child denies the question about playing outside and asserts ownership of the ball; interviewer agrees with the factual claim in line 32792.
Child asks if the object doesn't pinch/squeeze them; this is a claim about a physical property/fit.
Child asks if the object is not an album, seeking factual confirmation; Mother confirms it is an album in line 40538.
Negative imperative used to prevent Asaf from taking the item, in response to mother's directive to give it to him (lines 41688-41696).
Child denies that the other person took the object; SEF's response 'I made a mistake' (line 92751) confirms a factual dispute.
Child uses negative imperative 'al tiqxī' to prevent someone from taking her horse.
Child rejects the adult's questioning move to replace it with a request to see the candle.
Child asserts that the candle/fire is finished/gone; fits Nonexistence.
Child contradicts mother's claim in line 110082 that Miryam can do what she wants.
Child refuses the proposal to record on the tape (line 110728), preferring to wait for mom.
Child refuses mother's proposal to tell a story about Kruvi (line 110821).
Child responds 'loʔ loʔ' to mother's directive 'taʕazvī' (leave it/stop it), suggesting a refusal to comply.
Child states a preference ('I don't want rabbit cake') in response to a question about a photo album; no cake is offered, so it is a factual claim.
Child refuses the rabbit option in the context of an ongoing negotiation about which toy to bring/use, following the mother's mention of rabbit music.
Child refuses mother's proposal to take her/it in the stroller (line 116335).
Child refuses mother's directive to put the item in the trash (line 117070), confirmed by mother's response 'I don't allow it' (line 117079).
Child rejects mother's prompt for agreement/compliance following a directive to put trash away and subsequent scolding.
Child asserts she doesn't want the item after being told she cannot have it; no offer is present to be rejected.
Child refuses the caregiver's proposal to go to sleep (line 129053).
Child answers a factual question about whether they are going to kindergarten today (line 129110).
Child claims mother is not helping; mother's response 'loʔ' (line 173162) shows it is treated as a truth claim.
Child rejects Mother's proposal to tell a story about the 'Mess of Ariq' (line 194985).
The child is narrating a story and asserts as a fact that the characters did not find the pacifier.
The phrase 'Bli Sodot' (Without Secrets) is treated as a title/proper noun, as confirmed by the mother's follow-up question 'ma hayā ba# Bli Sodōt ?'.
Child responds to 'Where?' by stating she doesn't know the location of the piece; a factual claim.
Child refuses the book offered in line 229700; mother's uptake in 229703 confirms he doesn't want it.
Child uses a negative imperative to stop the father from saying a specific word ('mexashefa'), which is a prohibiting move.
Child makes a factual claim about whether pictures were taken from a location, confirmed by adult's follow-up in line 270896.
Child corrects the adult's identification of the object (disk/cassette) in line 271658.
Child asserts that there is nothing today ('ʔeyn klum'), contrasting it with the second part of the sentence.
Child contradicts the adult's claim that the object is an album, later specifying it is a book (line 272417).
Child corrects previous identification of an object as 'Mommy' (line 281476), asserting it is not.
Child corrects the adult's claim that they succeeded (line 282528), specifying the action of opening.
Child is playing doctor and asserts that the action does not hurt; this is a factual claim about the state of the patient.
The token 'af' here means 'nose' (body part), not a negation, in the phrase 'long nose' describing an elephant.
Child corrects the color of the balloon (not blue, but yellow) following the mother's correction in line 285012.
